housing-numbers.notes: 17-year plan period (2020/21 to 2036/37). Committed housing includes existing completions (2,189), sites with planning permission (2,992), SALP sites without permission (1,850), sites subject to s.106 agreements (859), and windfall allowance (1,220). Allocated housing refers to new Local Plan allocations (large and medium sites plus C3 specialised). Total supply exceeds requirement providing flexibility.
